cron.description: Five numeric fields, minute hour day month weekday (0 is Sunday): `*`, `n`, `n-m`, lists; `/step` after `*` or `n-m`

timezone.description: An IANA time zone name in its exact case, such as Europe/Berlin or EST5EDT, no UTC offset; the machine's when absent

precheck.description: A read-only command run before the workflow: exit code 0 starts the run, any other skips it
